question: Which economist has written the book "The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money (1936)"?
solution:
The option is **__John Maynard Keynes.__ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The General Theory of Employment**, **Interest, and Money** are a book by **English economist John Maynard Keynes** published in **February 1936.**
 
• **“The Price of Peace”**: **Biography of John Maynard Keynes** Wins Prestigious **Arthur Ross Book Award**.
 
• **John Maynard Keynes** is regarded as the** founder of modern macroeconomics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capitalism and Freedom** are rightfully regarded as one of the most popular **Milton Friedman** books and one of the best-dealing Friedman books. Capitalism and Freedom were **published in the time of 1962. **
 
• **Adam Smith** is also known as" **The Father of Economics**" or" **The Father of Capitalism**", he wrote two classic business units, The Theory of Moral Sentiments( 1759) and the Wealth of Nations( 1776). 
 
• **Essays in Economic Theory,** by **Vincent Crawford **was first **published in 1983.**
